title: Michelle Feeds the Garden
style: Upbeat future bass with psychedelic bounce drops, bright detuned synth leads, side‑chained pads, and punchy trap‑influenced drums. Wobbly bass swells, chopped vocal glitches, and sparkling arpeggios create a colorful, euphoric texture. The vocal is energetic and melodic with rhythmic, bouncy phrasing, supported by stacked harmonies on the hooks and spaced‑out FX tails for a dreamy community‑anthem feel.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[bouncy psychedelic future bass groove with pulsing synths]

[Verse 1]
[playful soulful vocals]
Watch it glow when she’s near
Michelle brings goodness here
Through the garden, seeds in her hands
Every color comes alive
When she waters, roots all thrive
That’s how much the harvest grows when Michelle is tending

[Verse 2]
Soft wind hums, kids all sing
Neighbors start to sway and swing
Psychedelic scents fill the air
Little sparks of neon vines
Grow along the sharing lines
Every day she’s feeding more life for the table

[Chorus]
Oh Michelle, when you come around
The veggies dance to that bouncing sound
Every stem feels the rhythm you bring
Sun up high and the children sing
Oh Michelle, every step you take
Fills the bowls we make, every meal we bake
Garden hearts keep feeding in time
Nourishing love through the roots of the family

[Bridge]
Catchy breezes spin and twirl
Hands reach out in loops and swirls
Psychedelic colors in the sky
Every leaf and every fruit
Finds its way from ground to you
Garden feeds Michelle, then the whole community

[Chorus]
Oh Michelle, when you come around
The veggies dance to that bouncing sound
Every stem feels the rhythm you bring
Sun up high and the children sing
Oh Michelle, every step you take
Fills the bowls we make, every meal we bake
Garden hearts keep feeding in time
Nourishing love through the roots of the family
